- Center piece: ~31 cm² × 0.5 cm ≈ 16 ml

Total ≈ 63 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Bacon is a dense, meat-like item (~0.9 g/ml). 63 ml × 0.9 ≈ 57 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Cooked bacon is roughly 540 kcal per 100 g. 57 g × 5.4 ≈ 31 kcal... but cooked bacon is fattier than the lean-meat average, so 57 g × 5.4 ≈ 308 kcal. (Correction: 57 g × 5.4 kcal/g = 308 kcal.)

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Three crisp bacon strips weigh roughly 15–20 g each when cooked, so ~50–60 g total is plausible. Around 300 kcal fits three strips of cooked bacon.
